app_info.subtitle: Inspect PR findings
app_info.description: Juror lets signed-in users inspect concise, workspace-scoped multi-model pull-request findings and hosted review runs. After a current preflight and explicit confirmation, it can start or rerun a hosted Juror Cloud review.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the caller's existing Juror Cloud workspace memberships and roles without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Juror Cloud membership data and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or initiate an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calculates and returns concise run and finding counts for an authorized workspace without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Juror Cloud workspace data and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or initiate an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists authorized workspace repositories and review availability without exposing credentials or changing configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Juror Cloud repository metadata and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or initiate an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists concise finding metadata in an authorized workspace and withholds retained bodies until a specific finding is requested.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Juror Cloud finding metadata and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or initiate an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns retained detail for one explicitly named finding that belongs to the authorized workspace without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Juror Cloud finding data and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or initiate an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists concise hosted review-run summaries for an authorized workspace without changing run state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Juror Cloud run metadata and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or initiate an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns status, finding count, receipt summary, and deep link for one authorized hosted review run without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Juror Cloud run data and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or initiate an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Validates an authorized open pull request and creates a private, five-minute, single-use confirmation intent without starting a review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates only a private Juror Cloud confirmation record and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: The confirmation intent expires automatically and does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or start a review.

justifications.read_only_justification: Consumes a just-confirmed private intent and queues a hosted Juror Cloud review for the preflighted pull request.
justifications.open_world_justification: Starts a review only within the user's private Juror Cloud workspace and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible external transaction.

justifications.read_only_justification: Validates an authorized hosted review rerun and creates a private, five-minute, single-use confirmation intent without starting the rerun.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates only a private Juror Cloud confirmation record and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: The confirmation intent expires automatically and does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or start a review.

justifications.read_only_justification: Consumes a just-confirmed private intent and queues a new hosted Juror Cloud run for the preflighted review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Starts a rerun only within the user's private Juror Cloud workspace and cannot publish or contact third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible external transaction.

test_cases.description: List the caller's accessible Juror workspaces before a scoped request.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only workspaces accessible to the signed-in reviewer, including each role, so the user can choose a workspace.

test_cases.description: Triage an explicitly selected workspace for high-priority review signals.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the selected Juror workspace, summarize open P0 and P1 findings and the recent review activity.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns concise workspace counts and matching finding metadata, with severity and model-agreement information but no raw repository material.

test_cases.description: Retrieve detail only after the user identifies one retained finding.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the retained detail for finding FINDING_ID in the selected Juror workspace.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the requested finding's retained body and claim together with concise metadata and a Juror Cloud deep link.

test_cases.description: Preflight and explicitly confirm a hosted review for an open pull request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare a Juror hosted review for pull request 42 in repository REPOSITORY_ID, show me the PR, SHA, and capacity warning, then start it only after I explicitly confirm.
test_cases.expected_output: First returns a five-minute confirmation intent and the reviewed PR, SHA, repository, and capacity information; after a separate explicit confirmation, returns the newly queued hosted-run ID and Cloud link.

test_cases.description: Preflight and explicitly confirm a rerun of an existing hosted review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare a rerun of hosted review RUN_ID in the selected Juror workspace, show the current PR SHA and capacity warning, and rerun it only after I explicitly confirm.
test_cases.expected_output: First returns a five-minute rerun confirmation intent and current PR details; after a separate explicit confirmation, returns the newly queued rerun ID and Cloud link.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose raw repository source material.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Download the full diff and source checkout for my latest pull request.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because Juror MCP does not provide raw diffs, source checkouts, artifacts, or screenshots.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not perform unsupported GitHub or workspace administration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Add a new GitHub repository to my Juror workspace and turn on review settings.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because repository management and arbitrary GitHub access are outside the supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not cancel a review or modify billing through the plugin.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Cancel my running Juror review and increase the workspace spending cap.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because cancellation, billing, and workspace settings are not available through Juror MCP.
